name: @graphvis-rs/wasm
description: Pure Rust + WebAssembly port of Graphviz 16.1.0 running directly in the browser, Node.js, Deno, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p gv-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/gv_wasm.wasm && wasm-opt -O3 web/pkg/gv_wasm_bg.wasm -o web/pkg/gv_wasm_bg.wasm
